title: Venezuelan Pickle Casserole Stir Fry
description: A unique fusion of Venezuelan flavors with a Chinese twist. This casserole stir fry combines crispy pickles with savory jagged meat.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add jagged meat and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add light soy sauce and stir to coat. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add Venezuelan pickle and cook until slightly caramelized, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in cooked casserole rice and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with chopped scallions.
